issue: Resolved configs name a normalization file; four-state training replaces the target scaler at runtime
detail: Recorded paths: four_state: /data5/tzhang174/TrafficFlow/xuancheng26/training_data_3s/window_data/normalization.json; legacy_single_channel: /data5/tzhang174/TrafficFlow/xuancheng26/training_data/window_data/normalization.json; phase3s_single_channel: /data5/tzhang174/TrafficFlow/xuancheng26/training_data_3s/window_data/normalization.json. Single-channel runs use normalization.json (global z-score, input scaler per penetration, shared full-inflow target scaler, fit on training days). Four-state engines call finalize_state_scaler, which reads state_normalization.json and uses one training-set scalar per physical variable. TLAST norm_flag=none is the published architecture switch, not a skipped scaler. Test JSON metrics are computed after denormalization, with MAPE only where the raw target is positive and with negative predictions left unclipped.
